say: Ananya Rao is your best route to Kalpana Merchant: Worked on two real-estate JV mandates under her at AZB.

person.name: Kalpana Merchant
person.bio: Ms. Kalpana Merchant has over 45 years of experience in the legal profession. She has significant experience in dealing with the commercial property matters. Her experience also spans diverse practice areas, including infrastructure, project finance and banking, dispute resolution, capital markets, and mergers and acquisitions, including joint ventures. She has been associated with, and has been a partner at, Kanga & Co., AZB & Partners and Jerome Merchant + Partners. She holds a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) degree and a Bachelor of Arts degree with a major in Psychology and is a qualified solicitor.
